verdict.rationale: Latham has a documented Executive Compensation, Employment & Benefits practice that handles "compensation, employee benefits, and employment issues," which plausibly covers hiring paperwork. However, no evidence shows it preparing offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements, and the LathamDrive generator is described only for incorporation documents. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements; employment templates in the LathamDrive document tools; independent corroboration.
